summary_cards.title: Early Source Region
summary_cards.detail: Path patching peaks at L5 residual d=4.15, with L4 mlp and L5 v_proj as the strongest early non-residual handles.

summary_cards.title: Late Controller
summary_cards.detail: Targeted steering winner L25_W32_A3 lifts recursive BT+ART from 0.42 to 0.67 on its frozen benchmark slice.

summary_cards.title: Readout Cluster
summary_cards.detail: Modern L27 validation remains extremely strong, recursive target-at-target mean 0.091.

summary_cards.title: Anchor Effect
summary_cards.detail: On ordinary baselines, anchor+bridge pushes BT+ART from 3.1% control to 16.7%, showing genuine induction beyond matched controls.

summary_cards.title: Persistence
summary_cards.detail: Induced anchor conditions stay clean over 24 turns, but persistence remains moderate rather than fully self-sustaining.

summary_cards.title: Subspace Winner
summary_cards.detail: At L27, subspace3_parallel @ 4.0 reaches recursive BT+ART 0.50 while baseline remains low.
